Customs

Gestion des Quotas

The process of monitoring and administering quantitative restrictions or limits on the import or export of certain goods, as set by trade agreements or national policies.

Quick answer: The process of monitoring and administering quantitative restrictions or limits on the import or export of certain goods, as set by trade agreements or national policies.

Questions and answers

Questions and answers

What is Gestion des Quotas?

In this glossary, Gestion des Quotas refers to: The process of monitoring and administering quantitative restrictions or limits on the import or export of certain goods, as set by trade agreements or national policies.

How is Gestion des Quotas used in logistics?

In logistics communication, this term appears in contexts such as: "Les systèmes de gestion des quotas veillent à ce que les volumes d’importation ne dépassent pas les limites fixées par les accords commerciaux internationaux."

Why does Gestion des Quotas matter in logistics?

Gestion des Quotas matters because it supports clear communication in Customs contexts for Freight Forwarders, Supply Chain Managers, and Customs Brokers. It also connects to aviation training and exam language such as FIATA Diploma, CILT Certification, and IATA DGR.

Who uses Gestion des Quotas?

Gestion des Quotas is mainly used by Freight Forwarders, Supply Chain Managers, and Customs Brokers.

What category does Gestion des Quotas belong to?

In this glossary, Gestion des Quotas is grouped under Customs. Related pages in this category explain adjacent procedures, commands and operational concepts.

Where does this definition come from?

This definition is sourced from Incoterms 2020 (ICC), FIATA, IATA DGR, WCO and published by Protermify Logistics as a static logistics reference page.

Definition

The process of monitoring and administering quantitative restrictions or limits on the import or export of certain goods, as set by trade agreements or national policies.

Operational example

Quota management systems ensure that import volumes do not exceed the agreed country limits under international trade agreements.

Localized term

Gestion des Quotas

Localized example

Les systèmes de gestion des quotas veillent à ce que les volumes d’importation ne dépassent pas les limites fixées par les accords commerciaux internationaux.
